vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: CVE.org is PUBLISHED and the Apache CNA advisory identifies Cassandra 4.0.16 as affected. In 4.0.16, ClientState blocks only CREATE/ALTER/DROP on protected auth tables, then Resources.chain walks table to keyspace to DataResource.root (ALL KEYSPACES). Thus MODIFY granted on ALL KEYSPACES authorizes DML against system_auth roles/role_members/role_permissions, including roles.is_superuser.

atomic_bic.evidence: git log -L independently traces the semantic change from an unconditional protected-resource denial to a DDL-only denial to 0b83682b40d3bace7bc0d604db46ddec78f2cd4a. That single-parent CASSANDRA-4898 commit simultaneously adds the CQL-backed PasswordAuthenticator and CassandraAuthorizer tables, making it the smallest public first-write of the exploitable mechanism; 2c3f9ba048af only changes equals() to enum identity comparison.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: Immediate parent ee0be0624b0ee1b2151b9be92a5d4e6334801cde exists and denies every permission on PROTECTED_AUTH_RESOURCES with Resource %s is inaccessible. The BIC diff adds PasswordAuthenticator.java and CassandraAuthorizer.java and weakens that guard, so the vulnerable mechanism is absent from the parent.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: The BIC has exactly one parent and is the atomic CASSANDRA-4898 first-write, not a squash or merge aggregate. The later 0cbc8d99f6e3cc5f592addb5ed9cc6f6c2280fc4 merge was separately decomposed: its 4.0-side ClientState blob f76e7e3a4f80 was retained instead of the patched 3.11-side blob 2416b8be1a1b, so that bad merge is lifecycle evidence, not the BIC.

affected_fixed_release_membership.evidence: BIC 0b83682b40d3 is an ancestor of both cassandra-4.0.16 and cassandra-4.0.17. Direct fix 066c489d764d54fc574d77c9006eb9d6399d4e93 is not an ancestor of cassandra-4.0.16 but is an ancestor of cassandra-4.0.17. The five relevant pre-fix Java blobs are identical in 4.0.15, 4.0.16, and the fix parent, despite 4.0.16 CHANGES.txt naming CASSANDRA-20090.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.evidence: Single-parent commit 066c489d764d54fc574d77c9006eb9d6399d4e93 explicitly re-applies CASSANDRA-20090 after a bad merge. It prevents ALL KEYSPACES from reaching system-keyspace roots, rejects invalid grants on non-virtual system keyspaces, and adds testGrantOnAllKeyspaces proving a user can modify a user keyspace but not system.local.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The BIC commit object attributes author and committer to Aleksey Yeschenko, says the patch was reviewed by Jonathan Ellis, and contains no AI, bot, generated-with, or co-author trailer. AI attribution was assessed only on this 2013 BIC; the direct fix's human Co-authored-by trailer was not used to classify the BIC.

findings: The primary record correctly distinguishes the original first-write BIC from the 2025 bad merge that left 4.0.16 unpatched.
The direct fix, release ancestry, and vendor advisory independently close the affected 4.0.16 to fixed 4.0.17 lifecycle.
The primary NOT_AI verdict is supported by BIC-only authorship evidence.
